name: GuideLLM (Red Hat): A100-PCIE-40GB, Ollama 0.9.2 (NUM_PARALLEL=32), Llama-3.1-8B fp16, peak aggregate output tok/s
unit: output tok/s (aggregate at saturation, concurrency up to 256)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY LAB MEASURED (Red Hat GuideLLM v0.2.1 study, Aug 2025; republished by Markaicode). Same host as the vLLM row: single A100-PCIE-40GB, CUDA 12.4, OpenShift 4.17.15. Ollama 0.9.2 with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=32 (the highest stable value on this card). llama3.1:8b-instruct-fp16. Peak output TPS at saturation; P99 TTFT at peak = 673 ms. AGGREGATE.
notes: Same-card, same-model, same-harness counterpart to the vLLM 793 tok/s record — the ~19x gap is a scheduler (continuous batching vs bounded parallel slots) story, not a hardware capability difference. Do NOT read 41 tok/s as the card's decode ceiling.
